note: Planning records, not measured results. Browser-local completion does not update these canonical records.

milestones.title: Confirm sensor and rig access
milestones.acceptance: Sensor model/interface/rate and rig/force instrumentation documented.

milestones.title: Repeatable physical contact rig
milestones.acceptance: Repeatable press/release with measured displacement and calibrated force where claimed.

milestones.title: Synchronized data acquisition
milestones.acceptance: Frames, forces, motion, timestamps, units, IDs and calibration provenance captured.

milestones.title: Contact model and sensor renderer
milestones.acceptance: Consistent deformation/force/image outputs for a bounded one-sensor normal-contact model.

milestones.title: Frozen calibration and evaluation
milestones.acceptance: Reserved object/session/trajectory evaluation with parameters frozen before scoring.

milestones.title: Accuracy/speed baseline and replay
milestones.acceptance: Matched baseline, physical/image errors, failures and complete timing/memory configuration.

milestones.title: Runnable Python interface
milestones.acceptance: Fresh-process configuration/reset/step example and reproducible benchmark command.

milestones.title: Synthetic-trained real perception
milestones.acceptance: Frozen model on held-out real measurements, independent labels and matched baselines.

milestones.title: Optional stage feedback control
milestones.acceptance: Tactile-driven one-axis controller evaluated independently across predefined physical trials.

milestones.title: Optional robot policy transfer
milestones.acceptance: Actual robot, frozen sim-trained controller, deployable observations/actions and repeated trials; separate hardware program.
